sources.title: Repository writing conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original guidance for clear, concise, and verifiable prose

claims.statement: One idea per sentence, active voice, stable terminology, unambiguous references, evidence beside claims, explicit uncertainty, comparison context, reader-appropriate detail, and removal of filler or duplicate summaries.

notes.title: Refresh Workflow
notes.text:
1. Review corrections and evaluations involving sentence clarity, terminology, evidence, certainty, and concision.
2. Update the smallest owning section.
3. Re-run trigger, routing, and output evaluations.
4. Update the review date after the guidance and evaluations agree.
